description: Find licensed AI voices on Worder by language plus free text: name, accent, delivery tag (warm, calm, energetic...), actor or sample label. Each word is matched on its own and the voices matching the most words come first. Returns the voice's per-second price in USD, its samples (as page links), the use cases its actor excludes, and links to listen and generate. Use list_languages to see what languages have voices.

language.description: A base language (English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Russian) or a variant such as "Spanish (Mexico)".

query.description: Free text: a name, an accent, a delivery such as 'warm' or 'energetic', or an actor.

name: search_voices
title: Search Worder voices
